definitions.explanation: A sculptural technique where figures are carved so they project from a flat background. Includes bas-relief and high relief.

definitions.gloss: bringing to light, highlighting, making clear
definitions.explanation: Making a problem, issue, or fact stand out clearly, as if in relief. Most commonly used in the figurative expression {浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになる (to come to light, to be highlighted).

examples.english: There are relief carvings on the temple walls.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{装飾|そうしょく}→装飾：14104_soushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大理石|だいりせき}→大理石：20505_dairiseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This decoration is made from marble relief carving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題点|もんだいてん}→問題点：20619_mondaiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになった。
examples.english: The problems were brought to light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{欠陥|けっかん}→欠陥：02793_kekkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになった。
examples.english: This incident brought the flaws in the system to light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The survey highlighted the disparity between regions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦インフラ→インフラ：09898_infura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{脆弱|ぜいじゃく}→脆弱：07523_zeijaku⟧さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Every time a disaster occurs, the fragility of the infrastructure is highlighted.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is far more common in modern Japanese. The key expression is {浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become highlighted / to come to light) or {浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to bring to light / to highlight). Very common in news and formal writing when discussing problems, issues, or facts that have become apparent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to come to light, to be highlighted
- {浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bring to light, to highlight
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: problems come to light
- ⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: issues are highlighted
